name: kotgent
description: Repository-aware task workflows using the kotgent CLI and git

interface.longDescription: Create, reconcile, review, claim, and execute repository tasks through the kotgent CLI and git, with pane-resolved session identity and concurrency safeguards.
defaultPrompt: $kotgent:create-tasks create focused backlog tasks from this implementation plan
$kotgent:sync-tasks compare the active backlog with this repository
$kotgent:take-task take the next eligible task and work it through review
